query:
-- Verify Paloma2 (w/ Display) is gone
SELECT COUNT(*) as paloma2_display_count FROM milestones WHERE product = 'Paloma2 (w/ Display)';

-- Verify RBM2 Refresh Product Commit is gone
SELECT COUNT(*) as rbm2_product_commit_count FROM milestones 
WHERE product LIKE '%RBM2 Refresh%' AND milestone_name LIKE '%Product Commit%' AND milestone_type = 'pdp_gates';

-- Show remaining PDP gates to confirm the list looks right
SELECT product, milestone_name, DATE(milestone_date) as date
FROM milestones
WHERE milestone_type = 'pdp_gates'
ORDER BY milestone_date ASC
LIMIT 20;
